presentation: Hyperosmolar hyperglycemic state — HHS, elderly Type 2 diabetic, extremely elevated glucose, profoundly altered and dehydrated, no acidosis or Kussmaul respirations
hint: HHS has higher mortality than DKA. Glucose may exceed 1000mg/dL. Neurological deterioration correlates with osmolarity not glucose. Fluid resuscitation is the priority — normal saline. Insulin is hospital administered. These patients are dehydrated by liters. Seizure risk from hyperosmolarity.
special_flags: higher_mortality_than_DKA. extreme_dehydration — liters of deficit. seizure_risk_from_hyperosmolarity
caller_behavior: elderly caller, hard of hearing, repeatedly losing track of conversation
time_of_day: 2100 — night beginning, alcohol and recreational drug factor increasing
weather: humid heat — heat index significantly above air temperature
special_circumstance: suspected abuse — mandatory reporting situation, perpetrator may be on scene
